runs.temporary_filesystem: workspace overlay (backing device not independently verified)

scope: Six concurrent operations per history include conservative/read-set/FIFO document transactions, atomic raw-key updates, indexed reads and competing unique-index inserts. The checker requires a real-time-compatible serial history and validates recovered documents, raw mirror and index integrity after every iteration. Temporary directories are local; reopen is a process-level recovery check, not a physical power loss or independent off-host restore. Schedules and failure states are not exhaustive.
note: The tmpfs test binary predates an additional checker self-test; the history workload and production engine code were unchanged. The recorded test and binary hashes refer to the overlay run.
